title: Study of attractors and fractal functions on the product spaces and Dimensional aspects
summary: In this paper, the product of the Hausdorff metric on the product space is defined and the equivalency between the product Hausdorff metric and the Hausdorff metric on the product space is established. The finite product of the iterated function systems (IFS) on the product space is considered and the relation between the attractor of the product IFS and the attractors of the co-ordinate IFSs is studied.
